raw_html: [[Nightshade Venom|Nightshade Venom 45]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Nightshade Venom|Nightshade Venom 45]]:''' Any creature struck by this weapon must succeed on a Difficulty Check 45 [[Fortitude save]] or fall unconscious. The target may attempt a new save to end the effect every several seconds; otherwise the [[sleep]] lasts for 20 seconds.
